source: ABB application manuals: 3HAC073319 / 3HAC073318 Externally Guided Motion (RobotWare 6 / OmniCore RobotWare 7), 3HAC050977 / 3HAC066560 SoftMove (RobotWare 6 / OmniCore), 3HAC050377 / 3HAC090251 / 3HAC083267 Force Control (RobotWare 6 / OmniCore Standard / Standard for GoFa, RobotWare 7). Names, argument names, types and option names from the manuals; summaries and argument descriptions in our own words.

egm6.source: 3HAC073319 Application manual - Externally Guided Motion, RobotWare 6 (IRC5)

egm7.source: 3HAC073318 Application manual - Externally Guided Motion, RobotWare 7 (OmniCore)

fc7.source: 3HAC090251 Application manual - Force Control Standard, OmniCore

fcgofa.source: 3HAC083267 Application manual - Force Control Standard for GoFa, RobotWare 7

entries.name: css_offset_dir
entries.summary: Alias of num: the direction (+/- x, y or z) of a SoftMove force offset or friction test.

entries.name: css_soft_dir
entries.summary: Alias of num: the direction(s) CSSAct makes soft (an axis, a plane, all linear directions, XY plus rotation about Z, or the arm angle of a 7-axis robot).

entries.name: CSSAct
entries.summary: Makes the robot soft (compliant) in the given Cartesian direction(s); a move must have run before it.

args.name: RefFrame
args.desc: The frame the direction is given in (default: the tool).

args.name: RefOrient
args.desc: A rotation of that frame (default none).

args.name: SoftDir
args.desc: The direction(s) in which the robot becomes soft.

args.name: StiffnessNonSoftDir
args.desc: Stiffness of the other directions, in % of the configured value (default 50).

args.name: Stiffness
args.desc: How strongly the robot springs back to its reference point, in % (default 50).

args.name: AllowMove
args.desc: Allow movement instructions while soft (raises the stiffness).

args.name: Ramp
args.desc: How fast the softness comes in, in % of the activation smoothness time (1-500, default 100).

entries.name: CSSDeact
entries.summary: Makes the robot stiff again (and drops any force offset); only in a stop point.

entries.name: CSSDeactMoveL
entries.summary: Linear move to a stop point (TCP at most 500 mm/s) that makes the robot stiff again on the way, dropping any force offset.

args.name: ToPoint
args.desc: The end point (a stop point).

args.name: Speed
args.desc: Speed of the move, at most 500 mm/s.

args.name: Tool
args.desc: The tool whose TCP is moved.

args.name: WObj
args.desc: Work object the target is given in (default: world).

args.name: TLoad
args.desc: Total load (tool plus payload) for this movement; needs ModalPayLoadMode 0.

entries.name: CSSForceOffsetAct
entries.summary: Adds a force offset in one direction to overcome static friction while soft (CSSOffsetTune finds a starting value).

args.name: OffsetDir
args.desc: The direction of the force offset.

args.name: Force
args.desc: The force offset in newtons (approximate).

args.name: ForceRamp
args.desc: How fast the force builds up, in % of the configured ramp (default 50).

entries.name: CSSForceOffsetDeact
entries.summary: Removes the force offset set by CSSForceOffsetAct.

entries.name: cssframe
entries.summary: Alias of num: whether a SoftMove direction is relative to the tool or the work object.

entries.name: CSSOffsetTune
entries.summary: Measures the static friction in one direction by raising a force step by step until the robot moves, and returns that force.

args.name: RefFrame
args.desc: The frame the direction is given in (default: the tool).

args.name: RefOrient
args.desc: A rotation of that frame (default none).

args.name: OffsetDir
args.desc: The direction to test.

args.name: ForceOffset
args.desc: Receives the measured friction force in newtons (VAR or PERS).

args.name: StiffnessNonSoftDir
args.desc: Stiffness of the other directions, in % (default 50).

args.name: MoveDetected
args.desc: Distance in mm that counts as movement (default 0.1).

args.name: ForceRamp
args.desc: How fast the force rises between steps, in % of the configured ramp (default 100).

args.name: DeltaAbsForce
args.desc: Size of each force step in newtons.

args.name: MaxTestForce
args.desc: Highest force to try, in newtons (default 500).

entries.name: EGM_MAX_RAPID_DNUM
entries.summary: Predefined num constant (40): the largest number of dnum values exchanged with the sensor (\DataToSensor, \DataFromSensor). The RW6 EGM manual files it under data types.

entries.name: egm_minmax
entries.summary: Convergence limits for EGMActJoint / EGMActPose: the deviation range (mm or degrees) within which an axis counts as arrived.

entries.name: EGMActJoint
entries.summary: Activates an EGM process for joint-mode position guidance and sets the data that stays the same between EGMRunJoint calls (tool, load, convergence limits, filter).

args.name: EGMid
args.desc: The EGM process, as reserved by EGMGetId.

args.name: StreamStart
args.desc: Also start streaming robot positions to the sensor (UdpUc setups only).

args.name: Tool
args.desc: Tool used by the following EGMRunJoint movements (default tool0).

args.name: WObj
args.desc: Work object used by the following EGMRunJoint movements (default: world).

args.name: TLoad
args.desc: Total load (tool plus payload) for the following EGMRunJoint movements; needs ModalPayLoadMode 0.

args.name: DOToSensor
args.desc: Digital signal streamed to the sensor (UdpUc setups only).

args.name: DataToSensor
args.desc: Array of up to 40 dnum values streamed to the sensor (UdpUc setups only).

args.name: DIFromSensor
args.desc: Digital signal received from the sensor (UdpUc setups only).

args.name: DataFromSensor
args.desc: Array of up to 40 dnum values received from the sensor (UdpUc setups only).

args.name: J1
args.desc: When joint 1 counts as arrived, in degrees (default ±0.5).

args.name: J2
args.desc: When joint 2 counts as arrived, in degrees (default ±0.5).

args.name: J3
args.desc: When joint 3 counts as arrived, in degrees (default ±0.5).

args.name: J4
args.desc: When joint 4 counts as arrived, in degrees (default ±0.5).

args.name: J5
args.desc: When joint 5 counts as arrived, in degrees (default ±0.5).

args.name: J6
args.desc: When joint 6 counts as arrived, in degrees (default ±0.5).

args.name: J7
args.desc: When joint 7 counts as arrived, in degrees (default ±0.5).

args.name: LpFilter
args.desc: Low-pass filter bandwidth in Hz against sensor noise.

args.name: SampleRate
args.desc: How often sensor data is read, in ms; a multiple of 4 (default 4).

args.name: MaxPosDeviation
args.desc: Largest allowed joint deviation from the start fine point, in degrees.

args.name: MaxSpeedDeviation
args.desc: Largest allowed joint speed change, in degrees per second.

entries.name: EGMActMove
entries.summary: Activates an EGM process for path correction during EGMMoveL / EGMMoveC: the sensor frame and how often corrections are read.

args.name: EGMid
args.desc: The EGM process, as reserved by EGMGetId.

args.name: SensorFrame
args.desc: Where the sensor sits, relative to the tool.

args.name: SampleRate
args.desc: How often corrections are read, in ms; a multiple of 24.

entries.name: EGMActPose
entries.summary: Activates an EGM process for pose-mode (Cartesian) position guidance and sets the frames and convergence limits used by EGMRunPose.
entries.syntax: EGMActPose EGMid [\StreamStart] [\Tool] [\WObj] [\TLoad] [\DOToSensor] [\DataToSensor] [\DIFromSensor] [\DataFromSensor] CorrFrame CorrFrType SensorFrame SensorFrType [\x] [\y] [\z] [\rx] [\ry] [\rz] [\LpFilter] [\SampleRate] [\MaxPosDeviation] [\MaxSpeedDeviation]

args.name: EGMid
args.desc: The EGM process, as reserved by EGMGetId.

args.name: StreamStart
args.desc: Also start streaming robot positions to the sensor (UdpUc setups only).

args.name: Tool
args.desc: Tool used by the following EGMRunPose movements (default tool0).

args.name: WObj
args.desc: Work object used by the following EGMRunPose movements (default: world).

args.name: TLoad
args.desc: Total load (tool plus payload) for the following EGMRunPose movements; needs ModalPayLoadMode 0.

args.name: DOToSensor
args.desc: Digital signal streamed to the sensor (UdpUc setups only).

args.name: DataToSensor
args.desc: Array of up to 40 dnum values streamed to the sensor (UdpUc setups only).

args.name: DIFromSensor
args.desc: Digital signal received from the sensor (UdpUc setups only).

args.name: DataFromSensor
args.desc: Array of up to 40 dnum values received from the sensor (UdpUc setups only).

args.name: CorrFrame
args.desc: The frame the corrections are given in.

args.name: CorrFrType
args.desc: What CorrFrame is relative to.

args.name: SensorFrame
args.desc: The frame the sensor measures in.

args.name: SensorFrType
args.desc: What SensorFrame is relative to.

args.name: x
args.desc: When x counts as arrived (default ±1 mm).

args.name: y
args.desc: When y counts as arrived (default ±1 mm).

args.name: z
args.desc: When z counts as arrived (default ±1 mm).

args.name: rx
args.desc: When rotation about x counts as arrived (default ±0.5°).

args.name: ry
args.desc: When rotation about y counts as arrived (default ±0.5°).

args.name: rz
args.desc: When rotation about z counts as arrived (default ±0.5°).

args.name: LpFilter
args.desc: Low-pass filter bandwidth in Hz against sensor noise.

args.name: SampleRate
args.desc: How often sensor data is read, in ms; a multiple of 4 (default 4).

args.name: MaxPosDeviation
args.desc: Largest allowed joint deviation from the start fine point, in degrees.

args.name: MaxSpeedDeviation
args.desc: Largest allowed joint speed change, in degrees per second.

entries.name: egmframetype
entries.summary: Alias of num: what an EGM correction or sensor frame is relative to (base, tool, work object, world, or joint values).

entries.name: EGMGetId
entries.summary: Reserves an EGM process for this motion task (up to 4 at a time); calling it again with the same egmident keeps the one it has. EGMReset releases it.

args.name: EGMid
args.desc: The EGM process, as reserved by EGMGetId.

entries.name: EGMGetState
entries.summary: The state of an EGM process: disconnected, connected (set up, not moving) or running.

args.name: EGMid
args.desc: The EGM process, as reserved by EGMGetId.

entries.name: egmident
entries.summary: Non-value type naming one EGM process; EGMGetId reserves it, EGMReset releases it.

entries.name: EGMMoveC
entries.summary: Circular move, like MoveC, with the sensor's path corrections added (set up with EGMActMove).
entries.syntax: EGMMoveC EGMid CirPoint ToPoint Speed Zone Tool [\WObj] [\TLoad] [\NoCorr]

args.name: EGMid
args.desc: The EGM process, as reserved by EGMGetId.

args.name: CirPoint
args.desc: A point on the arc, best about halfway.

args.name: ToPoint
args.desc: The end point.

args.name: Speed
args.desc: Speed of the move.

args.name: Zone
args.desc: Corner zone at the end point.

args.name: Tool
args.desc: The tool whose TCP is moved.

args.name: WObj
args.desc: Work object the target is given in (default: world).

args.name: TLoad
args.desc: Total load (tool plus payload) for this movement; needs ModalPayLoadMode 0.

args.name: NoCorr
args.desc: Run the programmed path without sensor corrections.

entries.name: EGMMoveL
entries.summary: Linear move, like MoveL, with the sensor's path corrections added (set up with EGMActMove).
entries.syntax: EGMMoveL EGMid ToPoint Speed Zone Tool [\WObj] [\TLoad] [\NoCorr]

args.name: EGMid
args.desc: The EGM process, as reserved by EGMGetId.

args.name: ToPoint
args.desc: The end point.

args.name: Speed
args.desc: Speed of the move.

args.name: Zone
args.desc: Corner zone at the end point.

args.name: Tool
args.desc: The tool whose TCP is moved.

args.name: WObj
args.desc: Work object the target is given in (default: world).

args.name: TLoad
args.desc: Total load (tool plus payload) for this movement; needs ModalPayLoadMode 0.

args.name: NoCorr
args.desc: Run the programmed path without sensor corrections.

entries.name: EGMReset
entries.summary: Releases an EGM process reserved by EGMGetId, with its setup and activation data.

args.name: EGMid
args.desc: The EGM process, as reserved by EGMGetId.

entries.name: EGMRunJoint
entries.summary: Starts a sensor-guided joint-mode movement from a fine point (activated with EGMActJoint); the switches choose the joints that move.

args.name: EGMid
args.desc: The EGM process, as reserved by EGMGetId.

args.name: Mode
args.desc: What happens at the end: hold the end position or ramp back to the start.

args.name: NoWaitCond
args.desc: Continue the program at once; EGMWaitCond then waits for the movement.

args.name: J1
args.desc: Move joint 1.

args.name: J2
args.desc: Move joint 2.

args.name: J3
args.desc: Move joint 3.

args.name: J4
args.desc: Move joint 4.

args.name: J5
args.desc: Move joint 5.

args.name: J6
args.desc: Move joint 6.

args.name: J7
args.desc: Move joint 7.

args.name: CondTime
args.desc: How long, in s, the convergence limits must hold before the move counts as done (default 1).

args.name: RampInTime
args.desc: Time in s to ramp in from the start position to full tracking.

args.name: RampOutTime
args.desc: Time in s to ramp back to the start position when Mode is EGM_STOP_RAMP_DOWN.

args.name: PosCorrGain
args.desc: Position correction gain, 0 to 1 (default 1).

entries.name: EGMRunPose
entries.summary: Starts a sensor-guided pose-mode movement from a fine point (activated with EGMActPose); the switches choose the directions and rotations that may change.

args.name: EGMid
args.desc: The EGM process, as reserved by EGMGetId.

args.name: Mode
args.desc: What happens at the end: hold the end position or ramp back to the start.

args.name: NoWaitCond
args.desc: Continue the program at once; EGMWaitCond then waits for the movement.

args.name: x
args.desc: Move along x.

args.name: y
args.desc: Move along y.

args.name: z
args.desc: Move along z.

args.name: rx
args.desc: Rotate about x.

args.name: ry
args.desc: Rotate about y.

args.name: rz
args.desc: Rotate about z.

args.name: CondTime
args.desc: How long, in s, the convergence limits must hold before the move counts as done (default 1).

args.name: RampInTime
args.desc: Time in s to ramp in from the start position to full tracking.

args.name: RampOutTime
args.desc: Time in s to ramp back to the start position when Mode is EGM_STOP_RAMP_DOWN.

args.name: Offset
args.desc: A fixed offset added to the sensor's value.

args.name: PosCorrGain
args.desc: Position correction gain, 0 to 1 (default 1).

entries.name: EGMSetupLTAPP

args.name: MecUnit

args.name: EGMid
args.desc: The EGM process, as reserved by EGMGetId.

args.name: ExtConfigName
args.desc: Name of the External Motion Interface Data instance in the system parameters.

args.name: Device
args.desc: The LTAPP device name.

args.name: JointType
args.desc: The joint type number the sensor tracks.

args.name: APTR
args.desc: The sensor is an at-point tracker.

args.name: LATR
args.desc: The sensor is a look-ahead tracker.

args.name: EGMid

args.name: ExtConfigName

args.name: UCDevice
args.desc: The UdpUc device name.

args.name: Joint
args.desc: Guide in joint mode.

args.name: Pose
args.desc: Guide in pose (Cartesian) mode.

args.name: PathCorr
args.desc: Use the device for path correction.

args.name: APTR
args.desc: Path correction from an at-point tracker.

args.name: LATR
args.desc: Path correction from a look-ahead tracker.

args.name: CommTimeout
args.desc: Communication time-out in s.

entries.name: egmstate

entries.name: EGMStreamStop

args.name: EGMid
args.desc: The EGM process, as reserved by EGMGetId.

entries.name: EGMWaitCond

entries.name: FCAct
entries.summary: Switches the robot to force control with the given tool (and work object), sets the force control frame and damping, and activates the supervisions set up before.

args.name: Tool
args.desc: The tool; its TCP is the origin of the force control frame (include sensor and plates).

args.name: WObj
args.desc: Work object most force control definitions refer to (default wobj0).

args.name: ForceFrameRef
args.desc: Whether the force control frame follows the work object (default) or the tool.

args.name: ForceFrameOrient
args.desc: Rotation of the force control frame from that reference (default none).

args.name: DampingTune
args.desc: Damping per direction in % of the configured values (default 100; 50 or more).

entries.name: fcboxvol
entries.summary: A box volume (min/max per axis, mm) for FCCondPos and FCSupvPos.

entries.name: FCCalib
entries.summary: Calibrates the force sensor for the load it carries (from FCLoadID); needed before FCAct and after every load change, without contact.

args.name: Load
args.desc: The load the sensor feels (mass and centre of gravity are used).

args.name: Recovery
args.desc: Calibrate even with contact forces present, e.g. to recover after an emergency stop.

args.name: IgnoreStandStillCheck
args.desc: Skip the check that the robot stands still.

entries.name: FCCondCombine
entries.summary: Combines the end conditions set up before (position, speed, force, time) for the next FCCondWaitWhile.

args.name: fccombcond
args.desc: The combination: FC_POSITION_OR_TIME, FC_SPEED_OR_TIME, FC_FORCE_OR_TIME, FC_POSITION_OR_FORCE_OR_TIME, FC_POSITION_AND_FORCE_AND_TIME or FC_POSITION_AND_FORCE_OR_TIME.

entries.name: FCCondForce
entries.summary: Sets up an end condition for FCCondWaitWhile: the program waits while the measured force (force control frame) stays within the limits.

args.name: XMin
args.desc: Lowest allowed force in x (N).

args.name: XMax
args.desc: Highest allowed force in x (N).

args.name: YMin
args.desc: Lowest allowed force in y (N).

args.name: YMax
args.desc: Highest allowed force in y (N).

args.name: ZMin
args.desc: Lowest allowed force in z (N).

args.name: ZMax
args.desc: Highest allowed force in z (N).

args.name: Outside
args.desc: The condition holds while the value is outside the limits instead of inside.

args.name: TimeOut
args.desc: Seconds after which FCCondWaitWhile stops waiting anyway.

entries.name: FCCondOrient
entries.summary: Sets up an end condition for FCCondWaitWhile: the program waits while the tool orientation stays within an angle of a reference orientation.

args.name: OrientCondFrame
args.desc: The reference orientation (default: the current one).

args.name: MaxAngle
args.desc: Largest allowed tilt of the z axis from the reference, in degrees.

args.name: MaxRot
args.desc: Largest allowed rotation about the z axis, in degrees.

args.name: Outside
args.desc: The condition holds while the value is outside the limits instead of inside.

args.name: TimeOut
args.desc: Seconds after which FCCondWaitWhile stops waiting anyway.

entries.name: FCCondPos
entries.summary: Sets up an end condition for FCCondWaitWhile: the program waits while the TCP stays inside (or outside) a box, cylinder or sphere.

args.name: PosCondFrame
args.desc: Frame the volume is given in (default: the work object).

entries.name: FCPress1LStart
entries.summary: Starts a pressing sequence: a linear move toward the surface that switches to force control when contact reaches the threshold; FCPressL / FCPressC continue it, FCPressEnd ends it.
entries.syntax: FCPress1LStart ToPoint [\ToNextPoint] Speed [\Fx] [\Fy] [\Fz] ForceThreshold [\ForceFrameRef] [\ForceChange] [\DampingTune] [\TimeOut] [\UseSpdFFW] [\DeflectionCompGain] [\PosSupvDist] Zone Tool [\WObj]

args.name: ToPoint
args.desc: The end point of the move.

args.name: ToNextPoint
args.desc: The following point, when ToPoint is too close for a corner path.

args.name: Speed
args.desc: Speed of the move.

args.name: Fx
args.desc: Contact force to build up in x, N.

args.name: Fy
args.desc: Contact force to build up in y, N.

args.name: Fz
args.desc: Contact force to build up in z, N.

args.name: ForceThreshold
args.desc: Contact force in N at which force control takes over.

args.name: ForceFrameRef
args.desc: Whether the force frame follows the work object or the tool.

args.name: ForceChange
args.desc: How fast the force may change, N/s.

args.name: DampingTune
args.desc: Damping in % of the configured value.

args.name: TimeOut
args.desc: Seconds allowed to reach the contact force.

args.name: UseSpdFFW
args.desc: Use speed feed-forward.

args.name: DeflectionCompGain
args.desc: Gain of the deflection compensation (OmniCore Force Control Standard; not in the RW6 or GoFa manuals).

args.name: PosSupvDist
args.desc: Position supervision distance, mm.

args.name: Zone
args.desc: Corner zone at the end point.

args.name: Tool
args.desc: The tool whose TCP is moved.

args.name: WObj
args.desc: Work object the target is given in.
